scope: Synthetic local implementation checks; not executor qualification
transport_profile: Plain HTTP stays HTTP. HTTPS uses a disposable locally trusted interception CA and HTTP/1.1; the child verifies the proxy leaf, and the broker independently validates the upstream TLS certificate and hostname using system roots. This is an instrumented TLS hop, not end-to-end TLS. Only the combined public trust bundle is exposed to the child; leaf private keys stay on the host. Clients using pinned certificates or independent trust stores can fail and require a typed incompatibility outcome.
checks: synthetic HTTP success and redacted events
host, port, credential and authority denial
private and mixed public/private DNS denial
matching HTTPS success; mismatched SNI and inner Host denied; untrusted upstream certificate denied
durable shared CaseBudget debit persists across broker restart
pipelined requests are rejected if read ahead and never forwarded as a second request
absolute per-handler deadline stops a slow body
HTTP-only configuration rejects CONNECT before DNS or upstream connection
redacted events capped at 10000 with dropped event count
durable prepaid credit falls back to exact remaining budget below one MiB
concurrent brokers cannot overreserve shared budget
unused credit remains charged after broker restart
partial send returns unsent bytes to local prepaid credit without refunding durable ledger
prepaid credit cannot be spent after time authorization expires or across ledger restart
limitations: Byte counter covers application bytes forwarded to and from upstream, not IP/TCP overhead, DNS, TLS framing, proxy control responses, or traffic outside this broker. It is not a complete network transfer meter.
The synthetic resolver and upstream trust overrides deliberately permit a local test endpoint and test CA; never use in real runs.
DNS timeout closes the request but a daemon resolver thread may remain blocked until the system resolver returns.

No live source, health data, candidate code, production, or autonomous agent was used. Redirect handling depends on clients issuing each redirected request through the proxy; the namespace must prevent direct networking.
Sandbox forwarder integration, concurrent requests and full resource controls require separate verification. Unsupported request forms fail closed; request bodies are limited to 1 MiB.

One MiB prepaid application-byte credit is charged before forwarding; no credit is refunded. Forwarding is serialized per broker; unsent bytes return to its local credit after a failed send. The reported forwarded count counts socket.send results, not remote receipt or wire bytes. Unused prepaid credit can be up to one MiB per broker; a process crash retains the full durable reservation. Broker lifetime must remain inside its time reservation.
